ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via InstallUtil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of .NET InstallUtil.exe in order to download arbitrary files. The files will be written to "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE\"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\InstallUtil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "InstallUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
